attributes.mechanism: Helper expansion changes the zero-copy choice at +0x34 while separating the former bank/part induction identities. The second loop's target index is defined by +0x9c `li r28,0`, byte offset by +0xa0 `li r29,0`; primary extraction reverses those two webs. Declaration swap restores them. Eliminating the redundant bankIndex local restores frame 56 to target 48; slotdiff on retained production reports target/ours 48/48, saves r26/r26, SLOT MAP IDENTICAL. Compiler internal identity mechanism is inferred from controlled source changes, not proven IR reconstruction.
attributes.probed_form: Shared helper exactly: static inline s32 AudioFindBank(char* bankName) { s32 index; s32 offset; index = 0; offset = index; while (index < gAudioBankTbl[4]) { char* name = (char*)((u8*)gAudioBankTbl + offset + 20); if (strncmp(name, bankName, 16) == 0) { break; } index++; offset += 292; } if (index == gAudioBankTbl[4]) { sAudioSuspend = 1; index = -1; } return index; }. Primary caller replacement bankIndex = AudioFindBank(bankName) leaves 14 words: five frame words and nine second-loop register words, but fixes the original +0x34 copy. Swapping only declarations `s32 partIdx; s32 bankOffset;` leaves five frame words. Receiving directly with `foundBank = AudioFindBank(bankName); bankEntry = (u8*)gAudioBankTbl + foundBank * 292 + 20;`, deleting bankIndex and its separate foundBank assignment, leaves nine register words. JOINT direct-result plus declaration swap reaches zero words at 75/75. This is the retained form.
